limitations.note: The fix needed to register the pre-edge value of the internal counter, but the rewrite exposes the newly incremented or loaded value one clock too early.
The rewrite asserts `zero` during reset and decodes the next count during operation, whereas the correct fix leaves the flag's reset value and pre-edge sampling unchanged.

The test expected a set value to appear on the same edge that loaded it and expected `zero` to be high during reset, so it validated the rewrite rather than checking the intended output latency and reset behavior.
